blocks.title: The auditor
blocks.text: Opinion not modified (a clean opinion), in the consolidated and standalone reports.

trail.text: The auditor lists exceptions to the audit trail, the software’s edit log.

src.label: Standalone report, page 208
src.quote: on our examination which included test checks, except for the instances mentioned below, the Company has used accounting software for maintaining its books of account, which has a feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility and the same has operated throughout the year for all relevant transactions recorded in the software: i. For data changes performed by users having privileged access (debug) ii. At the application level for certain fields / tables relating to all the significant financial processes Further, where audit trail (edit log) facility was enabled, we did not come across any instance of audit trail feature being tampered

src.label: Consolidated report, page 298
src.quote: on our examination which included test checks, except for the instances mentioned below, the Group has used accounting software for maintaining its books of account, which has a feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility and the same has operated throughout the year for all relevant transactions recorded in the software: i. blocks.title: Contingent liabilities
blocks.text: Claims not acknowledged as debt: ₹531 crore at 31 March 2026, ₹629 crore a year earlier. That is 1.7 years of FY26 profit. These are claims made on the company that it has not accepted as owed.

questions: Claims not acknowledged as debt are ₹531 crore, about 1.7 years of profit. Which of them is closest to a ruling?
